preview.text: The Voting System web application using Django is a project that serves as the automated voting system of an organization or school. This system works like the common manual system of election voting system whereas this system must be populated by the list of the positions, candidates, and voters. This system can help a certain organization or school to minimize the voting time duration because aside they can provide the voters an online platform to vote, the system will automatically count the votes for each candidate. The system has 2 sides of the user interface which are the administrator and voters side. The admin user is in charge to populate and manage the data of the system and the voter side which is where the voters will choose their candidate and submit their votes.

items.title: PINNs-based-MPC
items.description: We discuss nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) for multi-body dynamics via physics-informed machine learning methods. preview.text: We discuss nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) for multi-body dynamics via physics-informed machine learning methods. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are a promising tool to approximate (partial) differential equations. PINNs are not suited for control tasks in their original form since they are not designed to handle variable control actions or variable initial values. We thus present the idea of enhancing PINNs by adding control actions and initial conditions as additional network inputs. The high-dimensional input space is subsequently reduced via a sampling strategy and a zero-hold assumption. This strategy enables the controller design based on a PINN as an approximation of the underlying system dynamics. The additional benefit is that the sensitivities are easily computed via automatic differentiation, thus leading to efficient gradient-based algorithms. Finally, we present our results using our PINN-based MPC to solve a tracking problem for a complex mechanical system, a multi-link manipulator.

preview.text: LiME (formerly DMD) is a Loadable Kernel Module (LKM), which allows the acquisition of volatile memory from Linux and Linux-based devices, such as those powered by Android. The tool supports acquiring memory either to the file system of the device or over the network. LiME is unique in that it is the first tool that allows full memory captures from Android devices. It also minimizes its interaction between user and kernel space processes during acquisition, which allows it to produce memory captures that are more forensically sound than those of other tools designed for Linux memory acquisition.

items.title: redis-game-transaction
items.description: 在大型游戏中经常使用分布式，分布式中因为游戏逻辑会经常游戏事务，借助redis特性我们可以实现分布式锁和分布式事务。很多redis集群不支持redis的事务特性。 这个框架用来解决分布式服务器下redis集群事务失效的情况下,基于分布式锁完成分布式事务。支持独占锁，共享锁，读写锁，并且支持事务提交失败情况下的回滚操作，让开发者可以有更多时间侧重游戏逻辑.

items.title: hv-analysis
items.description: 横纵分析法深度研究：系统地研究一个产品、公司、概念、技术或人物。纵轴把它从诞生讲到今天，写成有因果的故事；横轴把它和当下的竞品或同类逐一对比；最后把两条线交叉，给出只看历史或只看现状都得不出的判断。必须联网取证。默认交付万字级的 PDF 报告和 Markdown 源稿，也可以按用户指定输出 HTML、只要 Markdown 或更短的篇幅。 用户说横纵分析、研究一下、帮我分析、深度研究、做个研究、调研一下、竞品分析、deep research、帮我摸清楚、帮我搞懂、帮我看看这个东西怎么样、这个产品/公司/概念是怎么回事、XX 是什么来头，或者丢来一个产品名、公司名、技术名词说“帮我研究一下这个”，只要是想系统地弄明白它，就用这个 Skill。 不用于一两句话能答完的名词解释（用户只是问“XX 是什么”），不用于公众号写作（用 khazix-writer），不用于只要标题或摘要的请求。
